user.title: Connect to Base Power
user.description: Enter the email address associated with your Base Power account. We'll send a one-time code to verify your identity.

select_location.title: Select your Base Power location
select_location.description: Multiple service locations were found on your account. Select the one you want to monitor.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Base Power
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Please sign in again to continue receiving data.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Base Power. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Could not start sign-in. Make sure this email is registered with Base Power.
error.invalid_code: The verification code was incorrect or has expired. Request a new code by starting setup again.
error.no_locations: No service locations found on this account. Contact Base Power support if this is unexpected.

abort.already_configured: This Base Power location is already configured.
